title: Ecuador's gang war
current_phase: Los Choneros and Los Lobos fight over Ecuador's cocaine export economy.

history.text: Ecuador became a major cocaine export hub after 2020.

what.text: InSight Crime describes Los Choneros and Los Lobos fighting over ports and prisons that serve cocaine exports.
Los Choneros leader Fito was extradited to the US in July 2025.
